subject: Essential Mathematics
title: Reflection

outcomes.text: identify lines of symmetry in plane figures,
determine the properties of reflection using objects and its image,
draw an image given an object and a mirror line on a plane surface,
draw an image given an object and a mirror line on a Cartesian plane,
draw the mirror line given an object and its image on a plane surface and a Cartesian plane,
Appreciate the role of reflection in real life situations.

content: reflection on a Cartesian plane (mirror line to be x=0, y=0, y=x),
inquiry_questions: How is reflection important in day-to-day activities?
coreCompetencies:
Learning to Learn: the learner develops relationship skills when discussing with peers the applications of reflections in real life such as use of mirrors in road transport.
Creativity and Imagination: the learner acquires connection skills when making cut outs of plane figures for finding the number of lines of symmetry.
values:
Unity: the learner takes turns when working with peers to make cut outs of plane figures used reflection.
Responsibility: the learner takes care of instruments used to construct images formed after reflection in the mirror lines.
pcis: Road safety: the learner discusses with peers the applications of reflections in real life such as use of mirrors in road transport.
transcription_policy: Source wording retained;bullets/line breaks normalised. Source pixels are authority.
notes: Road-mirror application is discussed safely in class;actual vehicle mirrors may be curved and do not share all ideal plane-reflection properties.
